cleavage agent: digested with Glu-C (C-terminal cleavage of glutamic acid, 1:50, enzyme:protein) and trypsin (C-terminal cleavage at arginine and lysine, 1:50, enzyme:protein)
collision energy: initial MS2 scans (normalized collision energy (NCE) 30%) were acquired
fragmentation method: For high energy collisional dissociation (HCD) analyses
instrument: NanoUPLC-MS/MS analyses were performed on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer
labeling: Ratios of unlabeled and 18O-labeled peptides were based on peak heights in the MS1 spectra
